body: Oaktree Acquisition Corp. III Life Sciences announced the rescheduling of its extraordinary general meeting to October 23, 2026 to permit further solicitation and voting of proxies.Key Highlights:General Meeting postponed from Oct. 16 to Oct. 23, 2026; meeting to be held at 10:00 a.m. ET in New York and virtually to allow additional proxy solicitation.Record date remains close of business on Sept. 22, 2026; previously submitted proxies remain valid unless revoked.Shareholders can attend in person by reserving with the CEO by Oct. 21, 2026, or join online at the provided virtual link to vote and ask questions.Shareholders may continue to request withdrawals of Class A ordinary share redemptions through the transfer agent until the rescheduled meeting.Original SEC Filing: Oaktree Acquisition Corp.
